post.description: Drive an existing Kling video (5s or 10s) with audio or text so the character speaks in sync (对口型). Pair with /kling/videos image2video for a full talking-photo pipeline.

video_id.description: ID of a Kling-generated video (e.g. from /kling/videos image2video), generated within the last 30 days. Provide this OR video_url.

video_url.description: Public URL of a 5s/10s video to lip-sync. Provide this OR video_id.

mode.description: audio2video: drive with an audio clip. text2video: drive with text + a voice.

audio_url.description: Public URL of the driving audio (required when mode is audio2video).

audio_file.description: Base64 of the audio file (required when audio_type is file). .mp3/.wav/.m4a/.aac, <=5MB.

text.description: Text to speak (required when mode is text2video, max 120 chars).

voice_id.description: Voice to use (required when mode is text2video).

voice_speed.description: Speech rate for text2video (0.8-2.0, one decimal place).

callback_url.description: If provided (or async=true), returns a task_id immediately and delivers the result via callback.

async.description: When true, returns a task_id immediately; poll via /kling/tasks or receive the callback.

example.detail: one of video_id or video_url is required
